<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Goblin King — Combined Lab v4</title><style>*{box-sizing:border-box}body{background:#141722;color:#e8e2d5;font:15px system-ui;margin:0;padding:20px}h1{font: bold 26px Georgia;color:#d6b577;margin:0 0 8px}main{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}section,aside{background:#202531;border:1px solid #414756;border-radius:12px;padding:16px}section{flex:1;min-width:300px}aside{width:310px}canvas{width:100%;max-width:920px;display:block;background:#10131a;border-radius:8px}button,select{background:#303747;color:#eee;border:1px solid #626b7b;padding:10px;border-radius:6px;font:inherit;margin:4px 0}select,input[type=range]{width:100%}label{display:block;margin:10px 0}output{float:right;color:#d6b577}small,p{color:#b8c0ce}button{cursor:pointer}</style></head><body><h1>Goblin King — Combined Animation Lab v4</h1><small>Approved artwork · jointed club arm · actual combat battlefield</small><main><section><canvas id="c" width="920" height="588"></canvas><p id="desc"></p><p id="status">Loading assets…</p></section><aside><label>Animation<select id="mode"><option>Idle</option><option>Royal Smash</option><option>King's Command</option><option>Earthshatter</option><option>Royal Guard</option><option>King's Fury</option><option>Death</option></select></label><button id="play">Pause</button> <button id="reset">Reset</button><label><input type="checkbox" id="loop" checked> Loop</label><label><input type="checkbox" id="ally"> Show Raider ally</label><label><input type="checkbox" id="rig"> Show shoulder and elbow pivots</label><div id="controls"></div><label>Scrub timeline <output id="timeOut"></output><input id="time" type="range" min="0" max="1000" value="0"></label></aside></main><script>
const sources={.../*SHARED_SCENE*/{},king:'data:image/webp;base64,'};
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),ctx=$('c').getContext('2d'),I={},P={};const C=(x,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x)),E=x=>{x=C(x);return x*x*(3-2*x)},mix=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t,T=Math.PI*2;
const modes={Idle:3400,'Royal Smash':1700,"King's Command":1800,Earthshatter:2300,'Royal Guard':1600,"King's Fury":1900,Death:2400};
const desc={Idle:'Anchored feet, adjustable sway and cape movement.','Royal Smash':'Overhead windup, club behind the face, ground slam and traveling rupture at Ironbound’s feet.',"King's Command":'Club raised, crimson energy empowers Raider.',Earthshatter:'Crouch, leap, heavy landing and erupting stone spikes.','Royal Guard':'Braced stance, reinforced golden arcane barrier and rotating ward glyphs.',"King's Fury":'Enraged posture, pulsing red body tint and crimson aura.',Death:'Both arms rise, violet energy gathers, then a large elite magical explosion.'};
const specs=[['speed','Playback speed',25,200,100,'%'],['size','King size',75,125,100,'%'],['sway','Idle sway',0,10,1,'°'],['rate','Idle sway speed',25,200,75,'%'],['cape','Cape movement',0,12,3,'°'],['lift','Shoulder movement',0,150,100,'%'],['elbow','Elbow movement',0,150,100,'%'],['swing','Club swing',0,150,100,'%'],['lunge','Body lunge',0,150,100,'%'],['fx','Effect intensity',25,200,100,'%'],['smoke','Death smoke scale',50,200,150,'%'],['jump','Jump height',50,150,100,'%'],['barrier','Barrier size',75,150,100,'%'],['blast','Death explosion size',50,180,110,'%']];
for(let [id,label,min,max,v,unit] of specs){let l=document.createElement('label');l.innerHTML=label+' <output id="'+id+'Out">'+v+unit+'</output><input type="range" id="'+id+'" min="'+min+'" max="'+max+'" value="'+v+'">';$('controls').append(l);$(id).oninput=()=>{$(id+'Out').textContent=$(id).value+unit;render()}}
const v=id=>+$(id).value,s=id=>v(id)/100,W=650,H=433,shoulder=[294,211],elbow=[245,255],hand=[194,281],neck=[280,165],hip=[393,298],capeJoint=[486,154];
const poly={crown:[[143,0],[343,0],[346,38],[320,65],[306,84],[290,95],[205,98],[174,79],[154,55]],cape:[[474,120],[530,142],[566,164],[600,200],[650,241],[650,433],[546,414],[508,379],[494,347],[536,286],[520,234],[504,188]],upper:[[294,184],[307,198],[302,222],[284,239],[270,247],[261,267],[242,271],[226,250],[235,222],[253,208],[269,180]],lower:[[0,110],[151,110],[183,217],[218,221],[246,239],[262,259],[254,278],[227,295],[278,329],[279,358],[211,357],[171,322],[150,307],[110,293],[0,275]],clubA:[[0,112],[139,112],[160,206],[177,231],[190,248],[180,264],[178,280],[157,285],[113,270],[0,275]],clubB:[[219,292],[251,305],[279,329],[275,353],[240,356],[215,333],[204,316]],head:[[143,80],[201,82],[304,78],[402,53],[402,107],[353,143],[319,173],[291,196],[248,210],[187,207],[162,177],[168,144],[164,114]],leftleg:[[248,267],[338,269],[355,328],[341,422],[193,433],[192,380],[238,338]],rightleg:[[418,266],[516,265],[549,342],[584,433],[430,433],[417,370]]};
function cv(){let c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=W;c.height=H;return c}function cut(im,polys){let c=cv(),g=c.getContext('2d');g.drawImage(im,0,0,W,H);let mask=cv(),a=mask.getContext('2d');for(let p of polys){a.beginPath();p.forEach(([x,y],i)=>i?a.lineTo(x,y):a.moveTo(x,y));a.closePath();a.fill()}g.globalCompositeOperation='destination-in';g.drawImage(mask,0,0);return c}function sub(im,parts){let c=cv(),g=c.getContext('2d');g.drawImage(im,0,0,W,H);g.globalCompositeOperation='destination-out';for(let p of parts)g.drawImage(p,0,0);return c}
function rig(){P.full=cv();P.full.getContext('2d').drawImage(I.king,0,0,W,H);P.crown=cut(P.full,[poly.crown]);P.lower=cut(P.full,[poly.lower]);P.upper=cut(sub(P.full,[P.lower]),[poly.upper]);P.cape=cut(sub(P.full,[P.crown,P.lower,P.upper]),[poly.cape]);P.base=sub(P.full,[P.crown,P.lower,P.upper,P.cape]);P.club=cut(P.lower,[poly.clubA,poly.clubB]);P.fore=sub(P.lower,[P.club]);P.head=cut(P.base,[poly.head]);P.leftleg=cut(sub(P.base,[P.head]),[poly.leftleg]);P.rightleg=cut(sub(P.base,[P.head,P.leftleg]),[poly.rightleg]);P.torso=sub(P.base,[P.head,P.leftleg,P.rightleg]);P.freeArm=cut(P.full,[[[435,130],[467,128],[489,143],[505,161],[519,181],[526,202],[533,222],[532,246],[525,266],[518,289],[503,309],[478,325],[455,312],[451,296],[459,278],[467,262],[466,249],[458,230],[452,212],[447,196],[432,175],[423,153]]]);P.noFree=sub(P.base,[P.freeArm]);P.noFreeCape=sub(P.cape,[P.freeArm]);}
let t=0,last=0,playing=true,ready=false;const K={x:359,y:285,h:165},A={x:234,y:285},target={x:109,y:193};
function sprite(im,x,y,h,w=h*im.width/im.height){ctx.drawImage(im,x-w/2,y-h,w,h)}function shadow(x,y,w){ctx.drawImage(I.shadow,x-w/2,y-10,w,20)}
function glow(x,y,r,col,a){if(a<=0)return;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=C(a);let g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);g.addColorStop(0,col);g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2);ctx.restore()}
function ring(x,y,rx,ry,col,w=1.5){ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=w;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,Math.max(.1,rx),Math.max(.1,ry),0,0,T);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}
function dust(x,y,r,a){for(let i=0;i<12;i++)glow(x+Math.cos(i*2.4)*r*.65,y+Math.sin(i*2.4)*r*.25,r*(.35+i%3*.12),'rgba(141,102,66,.7)',a)}
function at(p,a){ctx.translate(...p);ctx.rotate(a);ctx.translate(-p[0],-p[1])}function part(im,p,a=0,dx=0,dy=0,alpha=1){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=C(alpha);ctx.translate(dx,dy);at(p,a);ctx.drawImage(im,0,0);ctx.restore()}
function space(dx=0,dy=0,lean=0){ctx.translate(K.x+dx,K.y+dy);ctx.scale(K.h/H*s('size'),K.h/H*s('size'));ctx.rotate(lean);ctx.translate(-390,-H)}
function dot(p){if(!$('rig').checked)return;ctx.fillStyle='#ffdb68';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(...p,5,0,T);ctx.fill()}
const PAD=400,layer=document.createElement('canvas');layer.width=W+PAD*2;layer.height=H+PAD*2;const lc=layer.getContext('2d');
function pose(u=0,e=0,lean=0,dx=0,dy=0,cape=0,club=0,free=0,flash=0){
 ctx.save();space(dx,dy,lean);
 if(Math.abs(u)+Math.abs(e)+Math.abs(cape)+Math.abs(club)+Math.abs(free)<.00001&&!flash){ctx.drawImage(P.full,0,0);dot(shoulder);dot(elbow);ctx.restore();return}
 // Render each limb with its own joint; redraw the original head on top during the raise.
 lc.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);lc.clearRect(0,0,layer.width,layer.height);lc.translate(PAD,PAD);
 function draw(im,p,ang=0){lc.save();lc.translate(...p);lc.rotate(ang);lc.translate(-p[0],-p[1]);lc.drawImage(im,0,0);lc.restore()}
 draw(free?P.noFreeCape:P.cape,capeJoint,cape);lc.drawImage(free?P.noFree:P.base,0,0);lc.drawImage(P.crown,0,0);
 lc.save();lc.translate(...shoulder);lc.rotate(u);lc.translate(-shoulder[0],-shoulder[1]);lc.drawImage(P.upper,0,0);lc.translate(...elbow);lc.rotate(e);lc.translate(-elbow[0],-elbow[1]);
 if(!club)lc.drawImage(P.lower,0,0);else{draw(P.club,hand,club);lc.drawImage(P.fore,0,0)}lc.restore();
 if(u+e>.09){lc.drawImage(P.head,0,0);lc.drawImage(P.crown,0,0)}
 if(free){ // Near arm is in front of the torso and head; pivot at actual shoulder, not the fur mantle.
 draw(P.freeArm,[469,151],free);
 }
 if(flash){lc.save();lc.globalCompositeOperation='source-atop';lc.fillStyle='rgba(255,22,15,'+C(flash)+')';lc.fillRect(-PAD,-PAD,layer.width,layer.height);lc.restore()}
 ctx.drawImage(layer,-PAD,-PAD);dot(shoulder);ctx.save();at(shoulder,u);dot(elbow);ctx.restore();ctx.restore()
}
function idle(p){let sw=Math.sin(p*T)*v('sway')*Math.PI/180,cap=Math.sin(p*T+.7)*v('cape')*Math.PI/180;ctx.save();space();ctx.save();ctx.transform(1,0,-Math.tan(sw),1,Math.tan(sw)*H,0);if(Math.abs(cap)<.0001)ctx.drawImage(P.full,0,0);else{part(P.cape,capeJoint,cap);ctx.drawImage(P.base,0,0);ctx.drawImage(P.crown,0,0);ctx.drawImage(P.upper,0,0);ctx.drawImage(P.lower,0,0)}dot(shoulder);dot(elbow);ctx.restore();ctx.restore()}
function impact(x,y,q,m){if(q<0||q>1)return;let f=E(q),a=(1-f)*m;glow(x,y,25+f*15,'rgba(255,187,98,.95)',a);dust(x,y+10,10+f*30,a);for(let i=0;i<10;i++){let k=i*2.4,r=6+f*34;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=C(a);ctx.strokeStyle=i%2?'#dfb16f':'#fff2bc';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+Math.cos(k)*r,y+Math.sin(k)*r);ctx.lineTo(x+Math.cos(k)*(r+8),y+Math.sin(k)*(r+8));ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}}
function slash(x,y,q,m){if(q<0||q>1)return;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=C(Math.sin(q*Math.PI)*m);ctx.strokeStyle='#e9b77d';ctx.shadowColor='#e8ba86';ctx.shadowBlur=7;ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,65,40,-.5,-2.5+q,-.15+q);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}
function aura(x,y,p,m){if(p<0||p>1)return;let a=Math.sin(Math.PI*p)*m;glow(x,y-56,58,'rgba(181,21,24,.65)',a);for(let j=0;j<2;j++)ring(x,y-4,22+20*E(p)+j*8,5+j*3,'rgba(255,86,56,'+C(a*.85)+')');for(let i=0;i<18;i++){let f=(p*1.3+i*.13)%1,k=i*2.4+p*6;glow(x+Math.cos(k)*38,y-6-f*128,3+i%3,'#ff8a48',a*Math.sin(Math.PI*f))}}
function wave(q,m){if(q<0||q>1)return;let f=E(q),a=(1-f)*m,x=K.x-87,y=280;for(let j=0;j<3;j++){let r=8+f*(155-j*25);ring(x,y,r,Math.max(3,r*.15),'rgba(227,151,78,'+C(a*(.9-j*.2))+')',2.4-j*.45)}dust(x,y,14+f*59,a);for(let i=0;i<22;i++){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=C(a);ctx.translate(x+(i/21-.5)*230*f,y-Math.sin(Math.PI*f)*(9+i%6*5));ctx.rotate(i+f*5);ctx.fillStyle=i%2?'#8c6648':'#b08b63';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-3,-2);ctx.lineTo(4,-3);ctx.lineTo(2,4);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.restore()}}
function crack(q,m){
 if(q<0||q>1)return;let f=E(q/.55),a=(1-E((q-.68)/.32))*m,x0=K.x-105,x1=109,y=278;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=C(a);ctx.lineJoin='round';
 for(let j=0;j<3;j++){ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<=20;i++){let u=i/20;if(u>f)break;let x=mix(x0,x1,u),yy=y+Math.sin(i*2.1+j)*5+j*2;i?ctx.lineTo(x,yy):ctx.moveTo(x,yy)}ctx.strokeStyle=['#21140e','#9a4b23','#ffd18a'][j];ctx.lineWidth=[8,4,1.3][j];ctx.shadowColor='#ff8430';ctx.shadowBlur=j?7:0;ctx.stroke()}ctx.restore();
 for(let i=0;i<9;i++){let u=i/9;if(u<f){let x=mix(x0,x1,u);dust(x,y,9+q*13,a*.6)}}
 if(q>.5){let z=(q-.5)/.5;impact(109,276,z,m);spikes(109,279,z,m,5,32)}
}
function spikes(x,y,q,m,count=8,height=52){
 if(q<0||q>1)return;for(let i=0;i<count;i++){let delay=i*.035,age=q-delay;if(age<0)continue;let rise=E(age/.13),fade=1-E((age-.55)/.36),xx=x+(i-(count-1)/2)*15,hh=height*(.55+.45*Math.sin(i*1.7)**2)*rise,ww=9+i%3*2;if(hh<.2)continue;
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=C(fade*m);ctx.translate(xx,y+Math.sin(i*2)*3);let g=ctx.createLinearGradient(-ww,0,ww,-hh);g.addColorStop(0,'#35271d');g.addColorStop(.55,'#98714c');g.addColorStop(1,'#e2bc84');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.strokeStyle='#402c20';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-ww,0);ctx.lineTo(-ww*.65,-hh*.55);ctx.lineTo(Math.sin(i*3)*ww,-hh);ctx.lineTo(ww*.78,-hh*.43);ctx.lineTo(ww,0);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#d4a36e';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-hh);ctx.lineTo(ww*.78,-hh*.43);ctx.lineTo(ww,0);ctx.lineTo(1,-hh*.24);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.restore();if(age<.28)dust(xx,y,12+age*22,fade*m*.7)}
}
function guard(p,m){
 if(p<.18||p>.96)return;let q=(p-.18)/.78,a=E(q/.18)*(1-E((q-.78)/.22))*m,k=s('barrier'),x=K.x-8,y=K.y-84,rx=64*k,ry=83*k;ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);
 let g=ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,10,0,0,rx);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(227,174,75,.03)');g.addColorStop(.7,'rgba(230,170,49,.08)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,211,100,.5)');ctx.globalAlpha=C(a);ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,0,rx,ry,0,0,T);ctx.fill();ctx.clip();
 for(let row=-4;row<=4;row++)for(let col=-3;col<=3;col++){let xx=col*23+(row%2)*11,yy=row*20;ctx.beginPath();for(let j=0;j<=6;j++){let ang=j*T/6;let px=xx+13*Math.cos(ang),py=yy+13*Math.sin(ang);j?ctx.lineTo(px,py):ctx.moveTo(px,py)}ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,207,105,.35)';ctx.lineWidth=.7;ctx.stroke()}ctx.restore();
 for(let j=0;j<3;j++){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=C(a*[.7,.95,.55][j]);ctx.strokeStyle=['#7a4a18','#ffce64','#fff0b5'][j];ctx.lineWidth=[9,3.5,1][j];ctx.shadowColor='#ffc44d';ctx.shadowBlur=12;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,rx+j*3,ry+j*2,0,0,T);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}
 for(let i=0;i<10;i++){let ang=i*T/10+q*.8,xx=x+Math.cos(ang)*rx,yy=y+Math.sin(ang)*ry;ctx.save();ctx.translate(xx,yy);ctx.rotate(ang);ctx.globalAlpha=C(a);ctx.strokeStyle='#fff2bc';ctx.lineWidth=1.6;ctx.shadowColor='#ffbd45';ctx.shadowBlur=6;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-5);ctx.lineTo(4,0);ctx.lineTo(0,5);ctx.lineTo(-4,0);ctx.closePath();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}
 ring(K.x,K.y-4,rx,13,'rgba(255,208,94,'+C(a)+')',3);
}
function death(p){
 let m=s('fx'),k=s('blast'),raise=E(p/.28),charge=E((p-.18)/.38),q=(p-.58)/.42,x=K.x-10,y=K.y-86;
 if(p<.58){let shake=Math.sin(p*95)*charge*1.8;pose(1.03*raise,.32*raise,0,shake,-3*raise,Math.sin(p*18)*.045,-.15*raise,1.65*raise,charge*(.25+.35*Math.sin(p*38)**2));glow(x,y,25+55*charge,'rgba(209,38,255,.65)',charge*m);for(let i=0;i<28;i++){let f=(p*2+i*.037)%1,ang=i*2.399+p*6,r=(65-55*f)*charge;glow(x+Math.cos(ang)*r,y+Math.sin(ang)*r,2.5+i%3,'#f3a1ff',charge*m*f)}for(let j=0;j<2;j++)ring(x,y,18+charge*(42+j*10),12+charge*(35+j*8),'rgba(234,124,255,'+C(charge*.8)+')',2);return}
 let f=E(q),fade=1-E(q),radius=(12+110*f)*k;glow(x,y,radius,'rgba(167,25,246,.9)',fade*m);glow(x,y,radius*.52,'rgba(255,202,255,.98)',Math.exp(-q*6)*m);glow(x,y,radius*.2,'#ffffff',Math.exp(-q*9)*m);
 for(let j=0;j<3;j++)ring(x,y,radius*(.64+j*.16),radius*(.55+j*.13),'rgba(230,144,255,'+C(fade*m*(.9-j*.2))+')',4-j);
 for(let i=0;i<32;i++){let ang=i*2.399,r=radius*(.4+.6*Math.sin(i*7)**2),xx=x+Math.cos(ang)*r,yy=y+Math.sin(ang)*r;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=C(fade*m);ctx.strokeStyle=i%3?'#c957ff':'#fff1ff';ctx.lineWidth=i%4===0?3:1.5;ctx.shadowColor='#b14dff';ctx.shadowBlur=9;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(xx,yy);ctx.lineTo(xx-Math.cos(ang)*(10+18*fade),yy-Math.sin(ang)*(10+18*fade));ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();glow(xx,yy,4+i%4,'#9c48ee',fade*m*.8)}
 for(let i=0;i<7;i++){let ang=i*2.4,rr=radius*.6,w=28+radius*.42;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=C(fade*.55);ctx.translate(x+Math.cos(ang)*rr,y+Math.sin(ang)*rr);ctx.rotate(ang);ctx.drawImage(I.smoke,-w/2,-w/2,w,w);ctx.restore()}
 if(q<.8){ctx.save();space(-32*f,8*f);part(P.club,hand,-1.7*f,-45*f,55*f,1-E(q/.8));ctx.restore();ctx.save();space(22*f,-35*Math.sin(q*Math.PI));part(P.crown,[250,90],2.1*f,22*f,140*f,1-E(q/.8));ctx.restore()}
}
function render(){if(!ready)return;let mode=$('mode').value,p=t,m=s('fx'),sm=s('swing'),u=s('lift'),e=s('elbow'),l=s('lunge'),cp=Math.sin(p*T)*v('cape')*Math.PI/180;ctx.setTransform(2,0,0,2,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,460,294);ctx.drawImage(I.bg,0,0,460,294);shadow(109,280,126);sprite(I.iron,109,280,182,130);if($('ally').checked||mode==="King's Command"){shadow(A.x,A.y,80);sprite(I.ally,A.x,A.y,117)}shadow(K.x,K.y,110*(mode==='Death'?1-.75*E((p-.38)/.45):1));let charge=E(p/.25),ret=1-E((p-.68)/.32);
if(mode==='Idle')idle(p);
if(mode==='Royal Smash'){let w=E(p/.34),hit=E((p-.34)/.16),back=1-E((p-.66)/.34),a=(1.08*w-1.85*hit)*back*sm;pose(a*u,a*.38*e,-.16*hit*back,-40*l*hit*back,8*hit*back,cp*hit);if(p>=.50){impact(K.x-105,278,(p-.50)/.25,m);crack((p-.50)/.48,m)}}
if(mode==="King's Command"){let f=charge*ret;pose(.82*f*u,.32*f*e,-.035*f,0,0,cp*f);aura(K.x,K.y,(p-.27)/.65,m*.75);aura(A.x,A.y,(p-.27)/.65,m)}
if(mode==='Earthshatter'){let crouch=E(p/.17)*(1-E((p-.17)/.10)),flight=C((p-.22)/.36),air=p>.22&&p<.58?Math.sin(flight*Math.PI)*66*s('jump'):0,hit=E((p-.48)/.10),back=1-E((p-.78)/.22),a=(1.13*E((p-.12)/.24)-1.79*hit)*back*sm;pose(a*u,a*.38*e,-.13*hit*back,-18*l*flight*back,10*crouch-air+5*hit*back,cp+air*.001);if(p>=.58){let q=(p-.58)/.42;wave(q,m);spikes(K.x-80,279,q,m,9,64);spikes(109,278,q-.12,m,5,48);impact(K.x-80,278,q,m)}}
if(mode==='Royal Guard'){let f=charge*ret;pose(.30*f*u,.36*f*e,.035*f,5*l*f,3*f,cp*f,.08*f);guard(p,m)}
if(mode==="King's Fury"){let f=charge*ret;aura(K.x,K.y,(p-.13)/.85,m*.6);let flash=p>.15&&p<.96?(.18+.55*Math.pow(Math.sin(p*24),2))*f:0;pose(.44*f*u,.12*f*e,Math.sin(p*28)*.016*f,0,0,cp*f,0,0,flash);aura(K.x,K.y,(p-.13)/.85,m*.7)}
if(mode==='Death')death(p);ctx.drawImage(I.fg,0,0,460,294);ctx.drawImage(I.fade,0,256,460,38);if(mode!=='Death'||p===0)ring(K.x,K.y-6,38,8,'#e3c577');$('time').value=Math.round(t*1000);$('timeOut').textContent=Math.round(t*modes[mode])+' ms';$('status').textContent=playing?'Playing':t>=1?'Finished':'Paused'}
function tick(now){if(playing&&last){t+=Math.min(80,now-last)*s('speed')*($('mode').value==='Idle'?s('rate'):1)/modes[$('mode').value];if(t>=1){if($('loop').checked)t%=1;else{t=1;playing=false;$('play').textContent='Play'}}}last=now;render();requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
$('mode').onchange=()=>{t=0;playing=true;$('play').textContent='Pause';$('desc').textContent=desc[$('mode').value];render()};$('play').onclick=()=>{if(t>=1)t=0;playing=!playing;$('play').textContent=playing?'Pause':'Play'};$('reset').onclick=()=>{t=0;playing=false;$('play').textContent='Play';render()};$('time').oninput=()=>{t=v('time')/1000;playing=false;$('play').textContent='Play';render()};
Promise.all(Object.entries(sources).map(([k,z])=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{let im=new Image;im.onload=()=>{I[k]=im;resolve()};im.onerror=reject;im.src=z}))).then(()=>{if(!I.bg)throw Error('Shared scene missing');rig();ready=true;$('mode').onchange();requestAnimationFrame(tick)}).catch(e=>$('status').textContent='Asset load failed: '+e);
</script></body></html>
